prompts.layered_25d: Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Direction: LAYERED 2.5D HAND-PAINTED RPG. The main game view is SIDE-ON with a shallow oblique glimpse of horizontal walking surfaces, a clearly readable left-to-right footpath and bridge. Foreground dark banana/wood shapes, middle playing lane with separately drawn human sprites, next plane granary and stalls, distant reed riverbank and sky as SEPARATE FLAT PAINTED PLANES. Strong overlap, occlusion and clean plane separation suggest parallax without fake motion streaks. Do NOT substitute an elevated isometric 3D village vista. Characters remain confident full-body 2D hand-painted sprite designs; faces expressive mature, economical brush shapes, no glossy 3D shading. Paper-tempera material with broad opaque quiet color areas and selectively crisp working areas. Palette muted slate river, moss-green leaves, grey aged bamboo, earthy path, indigo cloth; one ochre accent on protagonist. No golden sunset blanket, no high-frequency photorealistic texture. The portraits and inventory icons use the exact same opaque brushwork and outlined silhouettes; UI is spare painted ivory paper with flat indigo divider strokes and ochre selected tab, mature readable typography. Board should unmistakably illustrate a layered exploration game screen rather than merely a pretty landscape. Create ONE wide 16:9 whole-game ART DIRECTION BOARD for an imagined living-world RPG in a fictional ancient-Vietnam-inspired village. Top approximately two thirds is a complete gameplay-screen mockup with navigation, a readable dialogue portrait/choices and a compact inventory. Bottom third has three practical sample panels: two full-body character designs, three large expressive portrait closeups, and enlarged inventory/journal UI/icon samples. Same story premise across the study: at a grain market beside a raised thatched granary and modest bamboo footbridge, a MIDDLE-AGED WORKING WOMAN protagonist, about 45, arrives carrying a small basket of tools. She has practical tied dark hair with a little grey, plain indigo short working shirt with sleeves rolled up, loose dark trousers, ochre waist sash, simple straw sandals, a strong ordinary face and adult body. An older grain-store keeper and a neighbor discuss the worn bridge before the wet season; families and baskets nearby imply community obligations. NOT a teen adventurer, not glamorous warrior clothing, no armor, sword, magic or sexualized outfit. The same woman and keeper must appear consistently in the main screen, full-body samples and portraits. Their cast is illustrative, no character customization or origin-selection controls. The main screen imagines a real-time 3D RPG with elevated three-quarter perspective around 35 degrees down, complete VOLUMETRIC props/buildings/adult characters, readable ground plane and physically grounded short soft cast shadows. Geometry is intentionally designed with compact clean volumes, planar rocks, simple leaf clusters and rounded aged bamboo; matte hand-painted local materials, moderate detail, no photorealistic pores, no plastic toy diorama, no isolated tabletop plinth. Character bodies are mature and solid; the middle-aged woman has broad human face planes, working hands, signs of age, practical proportions rather than chibi oversized head. Full-body and portrait samples are modeled-looking shaded designs of exactly that cast. prompts.pixel_life: Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Direction: CHUNKY AUTHORED PIXEL-ART LIVING-WORLD RPG. Entire board, including gameplay, human sprites, large portraits, item icons, UI borders and FONT, uses actual-looking deliberate SQUARE PIXEL CLUSTERS and stepped silhouettes on a consistent visible low-resolution grid. Main game screen has roughly a 384x216 native appearance, displayed with NEAREST-NEIGHBOR crisp scale; people about 24x40 native pixels, readable meaningful poses, not tiny realistic painted people. Elevated top-down three-quarter tiled environment, wide quiet walking tiles, modular thatch/stilt-house/bridge pieces, careful grouped foliage. Stylized 24–32-color visual palette, 2–4 shades per material, selective single-pattern dithering, NO smooth gradients, NO antialiasing, NO depth-of-field, NO realistic textures, NO painterly filter masquerading as pixel art. Pixel portraits should make the woman visibly middle-aged, tied grey-streaked hair, strong brows and lived-in face, and the older keeper distinct. The full-body samples remain enlarged SPRITE ART, not smooth anime illustrations. UI uses bold pixel frames, large neat pixel type with Vietnamese diacritics given generous room, discrete inventory tiles with sharp low-resolution icons, ochre bracket selected state, small pixel-scene journal sketch. prompts.anime_life: Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Direction: MATURE HAND-DRAWN ANIME EVERYDAY-LIFE RPG. Original 2D animation artwork, expressive precise variable-width ink contours, carefully designed mature faces and bodies, distinct silhouettes, TWO OR THREE DECISIVE CEL SHADOW VALUES per material, broad beautiful hand-painted background color groups. This is NOT a teen-school fantasy, idol cast, generic giant-eyed cute heroine or photorealistic people under an anime filter. Center a practical MIDDLE-AGED 45-YEAR-OLD WOMAN: visible age in eyes and cheeks, strong working posture, a few grey hairs tied up, adult proportions, modest work clothes. Older keeper and adult neighbor have diverse face shapes and convincing expressions, not everyone the same youthful face. Main screen has a gently elevated third-person over-shoulder animated shot, with protagonist at lower left facing granary keeper; background a clearly authored watercolor/gouache village set, depth through grouped color and line-weight rather than blur. Soft cloudy daylight, clear indigo/ochre garments, pale sky, lively but restrained greens, no all-over golden LUT. Portrait/dialogue art and full-body turnarounds visibly share SAME line/face rules; item icons drawn in clean cel paint. UI is refined clean cream panels with subtle indigo keylines, generous dark text, thin ochre underlined active choice, practical readable inventory and journal matching the illustration contours—not glossy sci-fi or ornate fantasy frames.
